title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Opinions on Serving and Guaranteeing Scientific and Technological Innovation with High-Quality Adjudication
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Issuance of the Notice on Opinions on Serving and Safeguarding Technological Innovation with High-Quality Trials

Fa Fa [2025] No. 1

To the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The "Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Serving and Safeguarding Technological Innovation with High-Quality Trials" are hereby issued to you. Please carefully implement them in conjunction with the actual work of trials. If problems arise during implementation, promptly report them to the Supreme People's Court.

December 31, 2024

Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Serving and Safeguarding Technological Innovation with High-Quality Trials

When technology prospers, the nation prospers; when technology is strong, the nation is strong. Innovation leads development; pursuing innovation is pursuing the future. In order to fully implement the spirit of the Third Plenary Session of the 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, further improve the level of judicial protection for technological innovation, serve and safeguard technological innovation with high-quality trials, promote the establishment of a system and mechanism that fully supports comprehensive innovation, and in light of the actual work of the People's Courts, the following opinions are hereby put forward.

I. General Requirements

(1) Guiding Ideology

Adhere to the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, fully implement the decisions and deployments of the Third Plenary Session of the 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China regarding technological innovation, deeply implement Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law, closely focus on the important task of constructing a system and mechanism that fully supports comprehensive innovation, deeply implement the innovation-driven development strategy, stimulate innovation and creativity vitality by deepening the reform of the trial system and mechanism, promote high-level scientific and technological progress with fair and efficient trials, and support and serve Chinese-style modernization with the modernization of trial work.

(2) Basic Principles

Adhere to the overall leadership of the Communist Party of China. Carry out all work centering on consolidating the Party's ruling foundation, integrate the Party's leadership into all aspects and the entire process of the People's Court's work, and ensure that the judicial protection of technological innovation always progresses in the correct direction.

Adhere to strict protection according to law. Focus on prominent issues and weak links in judicial protection in the field of technological innovation, increase the intensity of judicial protection, significantly shorten the litigation cycle, so that "genuine innovation" receives "genuine protection" and "high quality" receives "strict protection."

Adhere to overall coordination and balance. Better grasp the relationship between fair and reasonable protection and preventing the abuse of rights, better grasp the relationship between incentivizing technological innovation and maintaining fair competition, better grasp the relationship between high-level openness and high-level security, and ensure a balance of major interests.

(3) Overall Objectives

By perfecting judicial policies for technological innovation, improving the system and mechanism for judicial protection, enhancing the quality of specialized trial personnel, comprehensively improving the quality and efficiency of case trials, providing more powerful judicial services and safeguards for the achievements of technological innovation, the subjects of technological innovation, the acts of technological innovation, and the environment of technological innovation. The judicial protection system for technological innovation with Chinese characteristics, conforming to innovation laws, and meeting the needs of national development goals will further mature; the functional role of using high-quality trials to incentivize and protect innovation, promote technological progress, and social development will further become prominent; and the judicial capability to serve the overall work of the Party and the State will be further enhanced.

II. Strengthen Judicial Protection of Technological Innovation Achievements According to Law, Assist in Developing New Quality Productive Forces According to Local Conditions

(4) Accurately Grasp Judicial Policy, Ensure the Intensity of Judicial Protection is Coordinated with the Degree of Technological Innovation. In light of the development needs of new quality productive forces, further strengthen the guiding role of judicial adjudication on technological innovation activities, and increase the intensity of protection for innovation achievements. Apply existing legal provisions according to law, comprehensively utilize fallback provisions, principle clauses, and legal purpose clauses to provide timely and effective protection for innovation achievements such as key common technologies, and strengthen institutional supply for new fields and new tracks. For pioneering inventions and original innovations with a high degree of innovation that have a breakthrough and driving role in technological innovation, according to law, adopt stronger protection intensity, a broader scope of protection, and higher amounts of infringement damages to help enhance the capacity for original innovation. For inventions and creations with an ordinary degree of innovation, appropriately strictly apply the conditions for finding equivalency infringement, avoid improperly expanding the scope of patent protection, and prevent narrowing innovation space and harming the public interest. Reasonably delineate the legal boundary between civil rights and the public domain, protect the legitimate rights and interests of right holders, encourage inventions and creations, and prevent them from improperly intruding into the public domain and hindering technological innovation.

(5) Improve Trial Standards for Administrative Cases of Patent Grant and Confirmation, Incentivize High-Quality Inventions and Creations. According to law, properly adjudicate administrative cases of patent grant and confirmation, supervise and support the patent administrative departments in exercising their functions according to law, promote patent protection, and incentivize high-quality inventions and creations. Strictly grasp the novelty standard for invention and utility model patent grants. Compare the claims of the invention or utility model patent application with the relevant technical content of the prior art or conflicting applications individually, and do not make combined comparisons. If an invention and creation for which a patent is applied is disclosed for the first time within six months before the filing date due to public interest purposes such as a state of emergency or exceptional circumstances, it shall be determined according to law that novelty is not lost. When the technical solution itself differs from the prior art, and there is evidence proving that commercial success has been achieved due to this distinguishing technical feature, it may be determined to have inventiveness. Fully consider the objective limitations of patent document drafting, and within the scope disclosed in the patent application documents, as far as possible grant patents to inventions and creations that are indeed inventive, so that the rights obtained by the patent applicant match their technical contribution.

(6) Strengthen Judicial Protection of Industrial Designs, Promote Deep Integration of Technological Innovation and Industrial Innovation. Strictly grasp the judicial review standards for the grant and confirmation of design patents, based on the knowledge level and cognitive ability of the average consumer, comprehensively consider the design space of the design and the design characteristics of products in new technical fields, and help improve the quality of design patent grants. Considering the technical R&D characteristics, industry practices, and customary rules in the field of mass-produced chip R&D, reasonably determine the standard for completing development tasks in integrated circuit development entrustment contracts involving chip mass production; strengthen protection for original integrated circuit layout designs, combat illegal copying and commercial exploitation, and encourage innovation in integrated circuit technology.

(7) Strengthen Judicial Protection of the Digital Economy, Promote Deep Integration of the Real Economy and the Digital Economy. Accurately apply the Civil Code, the Personal Information Protection Law, and other relevant provisions, properly handle data disputes involving personality rights, property rights, etc., curb infringement, and strengthen data protection. Innovate technical means, promote anonymization of personal information used, and ensure information security and personal privacy when using personal information data. Promote the establishment and improvement of rules for the determination of data property rights ownership, market transactions, rights distribution, and interest protection. For data resources or data products that constitute compiled works or meet the requirements for works, provide effective protection according to law. Comprehensively consider factors such as whether the accused act violates business ethics, harms the order of competition, or hinders technological progress, and determine according to law whether data collection, acquisition, and other acts constitute unfair competition. According to law, combat acts of illegally obtaining or using data resources or data collections that constitute trade secrets, and other data use acts that may harm the order of competition. In accordance with the Anti-Monopoly Law and relevant judicial interpretations, regulate acts of platform operators using data and algorithms, technology, platform rules, etc., to reach monopoly agreements or abuse dominant market positions, and promote innovative development of the platform economy.

(8) Strengthen Judicial Protection of Technical and Operational Information, Perfect and Improve the Trade Secret Protection System. Accurately determine the scope of trade secrets by combining the field, carrier form, and information characteristics of the trade secret. Technical solutions reasonably summarized, generalized, and refined based on technical information not known to the public recorded in multiple technical documents, or information collections such as those recorded in a complete set of drawings, may generally constitute trade secrets. Reasonably allocate the burden of proof. Where the right holder provides preliminary evidence of having taken confidentiality measures and reasonably indicates that the claimed trade secret has been infringed, if the alleged infringer argues that the trade secret claimed by the right holder does not exist, evidence shall be submitted to prove it. According to law, handle dispute cases arising from the "job-hopping" of scientific and technical personnel, properly handle the relationship between trade secret protection and the reasonable flow of scientific and technical personnel, and while protecting trade secrets according to law, safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of scientific and technical personnel in employment and entrepreneurship.

(9) Strengthen Judicial Protection of Scientific and Technological Achievements in Key Fields, Assist in the Continuous Output of Major Original and Disruptive Scientific and Technological Achievements. Strengthen judicial protection of scientific and technological achievements in industries such as new-generation information technology, guide the healthy and orderly development of emerging industries. Strengthen judicial protection of agricultural scientific and technological achievements such as agricultural biotechnology, actively promote the establishment of a diversified and three-dimensional comprehensive legal protection system for germplasm resources. Strengthen judicial protection of innovative achievements in biotechnology, innovative drugs, etc., incentivize technological innovation development in life sciences and biomedicine. According to law, properly adjudicate cases involving intellectual property disputes related to traditional Chinese medicine. Combining the cognitive characteristics of technical personnel in this field and the laws of traditional Chinese medicine treatment, identify distinguishing technical features and prudently judge whether the technical solution is obvious, avoid simply applying evaluation methods for modern medical technology and underestimating the degree of innovation of traditional Chinese medicine technical solutions, and promote the improvement of the mechanism for the inheritance and innovation development of traditional Chinese medicine. According to law, properly adjudicate cases involving science and technology ethics, strengthen the governance of science and technology ethics, and promote the goodness of technology.

III. Strengthen Judicial Protection of Subjects of Technological Innovation According to Law, Fully Stimulate the Vitality of Innovation and Creation in the Whole Society

(10) Determine the Attribution of Rights and Interests in Scientific and Technological Achievements According to Law, Strengthen Talent Incentive Mechanisms. According to law, adjudicate disputes over the ownership of scientific and technological achievements and inventor qualifications, accurately define the legal boundary between service-related achievements and non-service-related achievements, confirm according to law the ownership of patent and other scientific and technological achievements, and support incentive system reforms such as the empowerment of service-related scientific and technological achievements. Protect the greater autonomy of scientific and technical personnel in the distribution of income from the transformation of scientific and technological achievements according to law, ensure reasonable returns, unleash innovation vitality, eliminate the concerns of scientific and technical personnel regarding the transformation of scientific and technological achievements, and solve the problems of "unwilling to transform," "afraid to transform," and "unable to transform." According to law, adjudicate disputes over the ownership of scientific and technological achievements between departing employees and the original employer. Comprehensively consider factors such as the departing employee's original job responsibilities and tasks and their relationship with the disputed technology, the original employer's relevant technical R&D work, and the evidence and explanations provided by the inventor or right holder on the source of the disputed technology, and reasonably determine whether it is a service-related achievement. According to law, adjudicate disputes over rewards and remuneration for service inventors, support reform arrangements such as science and technology incentives and income distribution, and protect the right of inventors to receive corresponding rewards and remuneration taking into account the quality and actual contribution of technological innovation. Infringement damages obtained by the employer based on service-related scientific and technological achievements, after deducting necessary litigation expenses, may serve as the calculation basis for the inventor's reward and remuneration. The transfer of scientific and technological achievements does not affect the employer's obligation to pay rewards and remuneration to the inventor or designer of the service invention.

(11) Adjudicate Technology Contract Disputes According to Law, Promote the Transfer, Transformation, and Utilization of Scientific and Technological Achievements. Respect the parties' autonomy of will, prudently apply grounds for contract nullity and rescission. Where the contract parties have the capacity to perform, the contract shall not be deemed invalid on the grounds of the party's lack of qualification. Reasonably grasp the circumstances of contract performance, fully consider the laws of innovation and the difficulty of R&D when determining whether the developer is in breach of contract. Strengthen protection of the legitimate rights and interests of the observant party. According to law, adjudicate dispute cases in the stages of technology R&D, achievement incubation, and industrial transformation. Reasonably determine the distribution of benefits and assumption of responsibilities formed in the stages of technology achievement development, transfer, licensing, pledge, technical consulting, and intermediation. Guide industry, academia, and research parties to reasonably agree on the attribution and distribution of rights and interests in scientific and technological achievements, promote deep integration of industry, academia, and research, and facilitate the transformation of scientific and technological achievements from samples into products and then into industries.

(12) Properly Handle Equity Allocation and Bankruptcy Disputes in the Field of Technological Innovation, Optimize the Operational Mechanism of Innovative Entities. According to law, adjudicate dispute cases of technological innovation enterprises, protect according to law the property rights and legitimate rights and interests of enterprises and entrepreneurs, and guide technological innovation enterprises to continuously improve corporate governance structures and establish modern enterprise systems. According to law, adjudicate disputes over equity incentives, shareholders' right to know, and the validity of company resolutions in technological innovation enterprises, respect governance structure arrangements that are compatible with the characteristics of technological innovation. Where technological innovation enterprises adopt a classified share arrangement, the principle of "same shares, different rights" shall be implemented according to law to protect the dominant position of the founding team, while also preventing abuse of rights by shareholders with special voting rights. Improve the enterprise bankruptcy mechanism, fully leverage the functions of bankruptcy trials in fairly clearing claims and debts, promoting survival of the fittest, and optimizing resource allocation. According to law, steadily advance individual debt concentration work with the function of a personal bankruptcy system, actively create a judicial environment that encourages entrepreneurship and tolerates failure.

(13) Properly Handle Education, Labor, and Personnel Disputes in the Field of Technological Innovation, Ensure the Normal Reasonable Flow of Scientific and Technical Personnel. According to law, properly adjudicate education administrative cases, coordinate the protection of citizens' right to education with supervising and supporting education administrative departments in exercising their functions according to law, promote educational equity, assist in the collaborative education of science and education, and advance the development of education, science and technology, and talent. Adhere to the concept of equally protecting the legitimate rights and interests of workers and the survival and development of employers. According to law, adjudicate labor and personnel dispute cases between scientific and technical personnel and employers, effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of scientific and technical personnel in scientific research institutes, institutions of higher learning, and other entities during the conclusion, performance, amendment, rescission, or termination of labor or employment contracts, ensure the reasonable flow of scientific and technical personnel to enterprise R&D institutions, and promote the establishment of an open and competitive talent flow mechanism. According to law, properly adjudicate disputes involving non-competition agreements, trade secret protection, and job-hopping and entrepreneurship of scientific and technical personnel. Reasonably determine the obliged subjects, economic compensation, and legal consequences of non-competition agreements. Accurately assess the fairness and validity of non-competition clauses, avoid expanding the scope of non-competition restrictions and hindering the independent career choice of scientific and technical personnel.

(14) Protect the Performance of Duties of Scientific and Technical Personnel According to Law, Stimulate the Endogenous Motivation of Technological Innovation Entities. Accurately understand and grasp the fault tolerance and correction mechanism that encourages innovation and tolerates failure, fully respect the laws of scientific research, grasp the characteristics of scientific and technological work, and protect according to law scientists' greater decision-making power over technical routes, greater control over funds, and greater authority over resource allocation. Prudently adjudicate criminal cases involving scientific and technical personnel in scientific research activities. Accurately grasp the standards for criminalization, correctly determine subjective fault, nature, circumstances, and degree of harm, accurately implement the criminal policy of combining leniency and severity, do what should be lenient and what should be strict, and ensure that the punishment fits the crime.

IV. Strengthen Protection of Acts of Technological Innovation According to Law, Resolutely Combat and Curb Various Types of Infringement

(15) Actively Leverage the Effectiveness of the System, Ensure that Innovation Receives Sufficient and Timely Protection. Leverage the effectiveness of behavioral preservation, property preservation, and evidence preservation systems. Where the situation is urgent and the applicant provides sufficient security, preservation measures may be taken directly without prior notice to the respondent according to law. Fully leverage the role of partial judgments to prevent ongoing damage to legitimate rights and interests during litigation. For disputes where the determination of infringement is not significantly disputed and the infringing act continues during the trial, behavioral preservation measures may be taken simultaneously with the issuance of a first-instance judgment or partial judgment upon the right holder's application. Refine and specify the specific forms of judgment for cessation of infringement to ensure comprehensive and effective cessation of the infringing act. Comprehensively consider factors such as the nature and circumstances of the infringing act and the possible damage and negative impact of violating non-monetary obligations such as cessation of infringement, and may simultaneously specify the calculation standard for the delayed performance damages for the non-monetary obligations involved in the judgment.

(16) Fully Leverage the Compensation System According to Law, Make Infringing Acts Pay a Greater Price. According to law, increase the amount of damages for intellectual property infringement, reasonably apply evidence rules and economic analysis methods, determine, compensate for, and recover market losses caused by infringement, ensuring that right holders receive full and sufficient compensation. Strictly examine and prudently apply statutory damages. Where it is possible to determine or estimate the actual loss or profit from infringement, or calculate compensation with reference to licensing fees, statutory damages should not be simply applied. The business scale publicly stated by the alleged infringer, the amount of damages agreed upon by the parties, etc., may serve as important references for the people's court in determining the amount of damages. Increase the application of punitive damages, support the right holder's claim for punitive damages according to law. Where the actual loss suffered by the right holder due to infringement or the profits gained by the infringer from infringement are difficult to accurately calculate, and there is no licensing fee for reference, the base for punitive damages may be reasonably estimated based on the evidence on record, and the multiplier for damages shall be determined by comprehensively considering factors such as the subjective malice of the alleged infringer, the means of infringement, and the scale and consequences of the infringement, fully exerting the deterrent effect of punitive damages. If the infringer reaches a settlement with the right holder acknowledging the infringement and cessation of infringement, and subsequently commits the same infringing act again, it may be determined as intentional infringement with serious circumstances. If the right holder claims to use the amount of compensation agreed in the prior settlement agreement as the calculation base for punitive damages, it may be supported according to law.

(17) Combat and Curb Acts that Obstruct Technological Innovation According to Law, Promote the Formation of a Healthy and Upright Scientific Research Ecology. According to law, regulate illegitimate acts such as false litigation, malicious litigation, and abuse of litigation rights that hinder innovation. Transfer suspected illegal or criminal leads to the competent authorities according to law, strictly prevent interference with the normal development of competitors through litigation, and avoid litigation becoming a means of obtaining illegitimate benefits. Coordinate and handle related cases, unify adjudication standards, and fully leverage the guiding role of judicial adjudication to prevent and resolve intellectual property infringement disputes. In intellectual property infringement litigation, where the right holder clearly abuses rights and hinders technological innovation, support the defendant's claim for compensation for reasonable expenses based on the plaintiff's abuse of rights according to law. Maintain scientific research integrity, severely punish research fraud acts such as fabricating or falsifying research achievements, buying, selling, ghostwriting, or ghost-submitting papers or project application and acceptance materials, and buying, selling, or falsifying experimental data. Severely crack down on the industry of research intermediaries buying and selling data and papers, combat falsified or fabricated patent applications and other abnormal patent application acts, punish acts of fraudulently obtaining money under false pretenses in the testing, development, application, and promotion of scientific and technological achievements, and maliciously conspiring to sign false research contracts. If a patent agency or patent agent uses another person's name to request a declaration of patent invalidity, or represents a patent knowing it is fabricated or falsified, the suspected illegal leads shall be transferred to the competent authority for handling. According to law, punish bribery and corruption crimes in the field of science and technology, increase the severity of punishment for bribery and corruption in national key projects, major scientific and technological projects, key core fields, and science and technology awards evaluations. According to law, punish crimes of dereliction of duty such as abuse of power, dereliction of duty, and engagement in malpractices for personal gain by administrative management personnel in scientific and technological activities.

V. Strengthen the Construction of a Legalized, Internationalized Market Environment for Technological Innovation According to Law, Assist in Building a High-Level Socialist Market Economy System

(18) Legally regulate unfair competition and monopoly in the field of technological innovation to help build a unified national market. Properly apply the catch-all provisions, principle clauses, and legislative purpose clauses of the Anti-Unfair Competition Law, using the principle of good faith and commercial ethics as basic standards, to effectively curb various new types of unfair competition that involve free-riding imitation and hinder innovation, thereby providing judicial norms and guidance for forming a fair and honest competition order. Adjudicate monopoly dispute cases in the field of science and technology according to law, accurately delineate the boundary between the normal exercise of intellectual property rights and the abuse of intellectual property rights to exclude or restrict competition, so as to both protect technological innovation according to law and effectively curb illegal monopolization of technology, ensuring that all types of enterprises can obtain innovation resources fairly, thereby achieving rational allocation and efficient use of innovation resources. Strictly punish acts that undermine fair competition and disrupt market order, such as platform-forced "either-or choices," big data price discrimination against existing customers, below-cost dumping, and forced tying, and guide the platform economy toward openness, innovation, and empowerment. Handle unfair competition and monopoly administrative cases prudently, eliminate market segmentation and barriers, break local protection and administrative monopolies according to law, supervise and correct illegal administrative acts by administrative organs that abuse their power to exclude or restrict competition, and promote the smooth flow of innovative production factors on a larger scale. Prevent and correct the use of administrative and criminal means to interfere in economic disputes according to law.

(19) Coordinate the relationship between patents and standards to help build a national standards system in the field of technological innovation. Properly adjudicate patent infringement and licensing fee dispute cases involving standards according to law, taking into account industry characteristics, the nature of the standards, and formulation procedures, and determine the legal responsibilities of the parties in accordance with the principle of fairness, reasonableness, and non-discrimination (FRAND) to help improve the national standards system. Reasonably balance the interests of patentees and the public, regulate the manner, conditions, and procedures under which the public can obtain implementation licenses, encourage the standardization of patents to promote the role of standards in technological innovation, while preventing standards from hindering technological innovation, achieving mutual promotion and a virtuous cycle between standards and technological innovation.

(20) Properly handle financial disputes in the field of technological innovation to promote the improvement of financial support mechanisms for technological innovation. Adjudicate loan dispute cases according to law, protect lawful private lending and corporate financing activities, broaden financing channels for corporate technological innovation, and guide financial institutions to increase support for technological innovation enterprises. Adjudicate security interest dispute cases according to law, recognize security interests made by enterprises through pledges of property rights such as intellectual property rights and equity, and help solve the financing difficulties of technological innovation enterprises. Adjudicate investment and financing dispute cases involving mergers, capital increases, and equity transfers of technological innovation enterprises according to law, protect the legitimate rights and interests of social capital that invests early, invests small, invests long-term, and invests in hard technologies in participating in corporate governance of technological innovation enterprises and obtaining returns. Further optimize the working mechanism for adjudicating and enforcing cases of arrears owed to technological innovation enterprises to ensure timely realization of winning parties' rights and interests. Leverage the function of financial adjudication, optimize the adjudication mechanism for financial disputes related to the Science and Technology Innovation Board (STAR Market), accelerate the adjudication of cases involving technological innovation enterprises according to law, and ensure that finance supports technological innovation. Improve adjudication rules for venture capital funds and private equity investment funds, strengthen the fiduciary duties and legal responsibilities of fund managers, custodians, and service institutions, smooth all aspects of fund raising, investment, management, and exit, and promote the function of equity financing in supporting technological innovation. Provide judicial guarantees for the capital market, promote the functions of the main board, STAR Market, ChiNext, Beijing Stock Exchange, New Third Board, and regional equity markets, and meet the equity financing needs of different types and lifecycle stages of technological innovation enterprises.

(21) Properly handle foreign-related disputes in the field of technological innovation to promote international cooperation and exchanges in technological innovation. Equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese and foreign parties according to law, ensure equal treatment of all types of market entities, support reforms in pilot free trade zones, promptly summarize successful experiences from the pilot zones and promote them on a larger scale, and assist in deepening reforms and high-level opening up. Adjudicate dispute cases involving Chinese and foreign enterprises in equity participation mergers and acquisitions, joint development, patent cross-licensing, and foreign investment in establishing R&D institutions in China, promote the introduction of international science and technology resources, and advance comprehensive, multi-level, and high-level international cooperation in science and technology. Support parties' agreements on choice of forum and applicable law in foreign-related civil and commercial cases according to law. Strictly implement the Convention Abolishing the Requirement of Legalisation for Foreign Public Documents (Apostille Convention), simplifying the proof requirements for foreign public documents in accordance with the Convention. Actively render more internationally leading judicial judgments, use vivid and concrete judicial protection cases to tell the story of China's rule of law, help cultivate an "innovation-friendly" international environment, and create a stronger attraction for global innovation resources. Strengthen international judicial exchanges and cooperation, participate in the reform and construction of the global governance system, and help build an open, fair, just, and non-discriminatory international environment for science and technology development.

(22) Deepen regional judicial cooperation in intellectual property protection to build an open regional collaborative innovation community. Fully leverage the scientific R&D and industrial innovation advantages of regions such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, the Yangtze River Delta, the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, Xiongan New Area, and Chengdu-Chongqing, deepen regional cooperation in intellectual property judicial protection, and strive to build a "preferred venue" for intellectual property dispute resolution with strong radiating effect and international and interregional influence. Further improve the intellectual property adjudication mechanism, enrich, develop, and perfect the judicial protection system for intellectual property conducive to incentivizing innovation, and assist in building an open, integrated, and collaborative regional innovation community.

6. Improving the Judicial System and Mechanisms to Better Serve and Guarantee the Implementation of the Innovation-Driven Development Strategy

(23) Deepen the reform of the adjudication system and mechanisms to enhance overall effectiveness. Regulate the procedures for handling criminal intellectual property cases, promote orderly coordination among investigation, prosecution, trial, and enforcement, and punish criminal infringement of intellectual property rights according to law. Strengthen communication and coordination with public security organs and procuratorial organs in criminal judicial procedures for intellectual property cases, establish and improve liaison mechanisms. Improve coordination among civil, administrative, and criminal litigation procedures in intellectual property cases to ensure consistent adjudication results. Further promote the coordinated adjudication of patent grant and invalidation administrative cases and civil infringement cases, ensure uniform adjudication standards, and strive to shorten the dispute resolution cycle.

(24) Standardize the construction of specialized adjudication institutions to optimize rule-of-law effectiveness. Implement the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China's requirements on continuing to deepen the reform of the national-level appellate mechanism for intellectual property cases, further summarize and improve the pilot experience of the Intellectual Property Tribunal of the Supreme People's Court, cooperate with institutional establishment departments to optimize functional allocations, and strengthen the basic guarantees of personnel, finances, and materials. Further standardize and improve the establishment of intellectual property courts and intellectual property tribunals, optimize the layout of specialized intellectual property adjudication institutions, and promote the formulation of special procedural laws that suit the characteristics of intellectual property cases. Strengthen the intellectual property adjudication functions of internet courts, fully leverage the leading role of internet justice, and focus on solving new problems in intellectual property protection in the information age.

(25) Strengthen the construction of adjudication capacity and promote technological empowerment. Strengthen the construction of professional adjudication teams for technology-related cases and talent cultivation, increase the selection of interdisciplinary adjudication talents with backgrounds in science, engineering, and law, and maintain the relative stability of professional adjudication teams. Fully leverage the role of the intellectual property adjudication departments of the Supreme People's Court, intellectual property courts, and intellectual property tribunals as talent cultivation bases. Strengthen the construction of the People's Courts Case Database and the Legal Q&A Network (Fada Wang) to promote uniform application of law and adjudication standards. Enhance the informatization level of courts nationwide, promote the integration and sharing of data with relevant units, local platform data, and business system data. Deepen the application of judicial big data analysis and digital model services to form a highly integrated, efficient, collaborative, intelligent, and precise integrated development pattern for digital courts.
